title: Use colours correctly

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Keep palette strength consistent because tinting and transparency can turn recognizable colors into uncontrolled variants.
strategic_value: Full-strength Helsinki colors can maintain a clear common vocabulary across applications.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section states the 100% color rule and shows three crossed-out treatments: partial-intensity blocks, a gradient and overlapping translucent fields.
practical_value: Check that a palette color has not become a tint, gradient or translucent layer.

content_islands.name: Intensity rule
content_islands.spec: State the 100% requirement above the examples.

content_islands.name: Prohibited treatments
content_islands.spec: Place the three crossed-out tint, gradient and transparency examples in a horizontal row.

ingredient.name: Full-strength palette color
ingredient.application: Use colors at 100%, without tinting, gradients or translucency.
ingredient.scope: Applies to the city visual-identity colors in this guidance; does not prescribe area proportions within a composition.

reference_purposes.Application: The three crossed-out examples make disallowed color treatments inspectable.
reference_purposes.Constraint: All colors use 100%; partial-intensity colors, gradients and translucency are prohibited.
